complexity.notes: Bare `except` to catch missing keys is poor style; `dict.get(i, 0)` or `collections.Counter` would be cleaner. The two comparison loops are redundant with each other, and equality of the two dicts could be checked directly with `multiset_s == multiset_t`. A length check up front would also short-circuit mismatched inputs.
complexity.summary: Builds a character frequency dict for each string, then verifies the two multisets contain identical counts by iterating over both dicts. Anagrams are detected when all counts match.
